subtopics.mastery: Mastery: solve an unfamiliar elimination task independently, explain the decisive evidence or principle, reject a plausible distractor, and verify the conclusion.

subtopics.title: accuracy
subtopics.teaching: Master accuracy within Competition Mastery for Mega Inter-School Championship. Build precise concepts and terminology first, then connect them to examples, interpretation and competition-style reasoning. Students should distinguish evidence from assumption, compare alternatives, and justify conclusions rather than relying on memorised associations.
